projectDescription: A meta-framework for building AI agents, workflows, and triggers — comparable to how Next.js wraps React, Keystroke provides conventions, a CLI, and a runtime so you can focus on writing agent logic.
keyFeatures: File-based discovery: place files in agents/, workflows/, triggers/, actions/ and routes are auto-mounted
defineAgent — LLM agents with typed tools, skills, and sandbox workspaces
defineWorkflow — durable, replayable orchestration of actions and agents
defineAction — reusable typed steps usable in both workflows and agent tool lists
Three trigger types: webhook, cron, and poll — attach to any workflow or agent
Built-in integrations: Slack (gateway + actions), Google (Gmail + Calendar), Exa Search
MCP (Model Context Protocol) client support via @keystrokehq/mcp
Credential vault with typed schemas and OAuth provider management
keystroke CLI: init, dev, start, build, deploy commands
Typed TypeScript SDK (@keystrokehq/sdk) for calling agents, workflows, and triggers
OpenAPI spec auto-generated from discovered routes (GET /openapi.json)
Agent skills: markdown playbooks injected into agent context
Sandbox workspaces: isolated file environments for agents and workflows
SQLite by default locally; Postgres for production
publicApiSurface: defineAgent({ slug, systemPrompt, model, tools, skills, files, runtimeProvider })
defineWorkflow({ slug, input, output, run, sandbox })
defineAction({ slug, name, input, output, credentials, run })
defineWebhookSource({ key, endpoint, request, filter }).attach({ workflow, transform })
definePollSource({ key, run, schedule }).attach({ workflow, transform })
defineMcp({ name, url }) — MCP server definition
@keystrokehq/google: gmail actions (sendEmail, listEmails, getEmail), calendar actions (listEvents, createEvent, updateEvent, deleteEvent)
